messages.subject: Implementing Shiny on squarespace website
parts:
Hello all. I have a very simple question but have not seen it done and squarespace has never heard of it so I have to ask here. I would like to start developing web dashboards on my squarespace website and was wondering if I could use shiny instead of learning JavaScript? Again, no one else seems to know the answer so I wanted to ask here. Thanks

Brandon

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Implementing Shiny on squarespace website
parts:
It's not possible to host Shiny apps directly on Squarespace hardware. Shiny apps require a running R process to do the calculations, and that's not something that Squarespace does (nor any other general purpose web host).

What you could maybe do is create a dashboard on shinyapps.io and make an iframe on Squarespace that embeds the dashboard.
